svg.title: Prism: rack and decile gauges
svg.desc: Plate five, Prism, illustrative and not a reported result: a rack reads a paraphrased section 87A rebate clause and drives ten income-decile gauges, each with an expert-coding needle and an LLM-extraction needle. They agree except in deciles 5 to 7, and a trace runs from those gauges back to the words '₹25,000' in the clause. Prism parses Indian statutes into a legal AST, extracts rules grounded to exact spans, simulates them on a population matching official Income Tax Return statistics, and traces each divergence to its clause.
